name: statica-mcp
description: Brings Suresoft STATIC static analysis into an MCP client: connect a project, analyze changed files, upload a full analysis, manage rulesets, metrics, scope and reports. Requires a local STATIC installation; without one the server reports a single environment check.
long_description:
STATICA exposes Suresoft STATIC's static analysis to an MCP client. STATIC produces the findings; these tools prepare, run and report that analysis and never fix defects in source code.

The server forwards each call to the plugin's own command-line runtime on the same machine. Connecting a project is a guided, approval-gated flow: read the bundled procedure with statica_get_guide and follow it. A full upload creates a team-visible revision on the STATIC server and runs only when asked.

A local STATIC installation (with ARACHNE_INSTALL_PATH set, or the install path supplied in this bundle's configuration) and Python 3.10+ are required. Without STATIC the server still starts and statica_doctor reports what is missing, so it is safe to leave configured on any machine.

install_path.title: STATIC installation directory
install_path.description: Leave empty when ARACHNE_INSTALL_PATH is already set on this machine. Set it only to point STATICA at a STATIC installation that the environment does not already expose.
